rationale: C15 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template for the child. It culminates in a proposal declaring readiness to meet Soviet leaders, including leaders of other responsible states, after diplomatic preparation of a top-level conference intended to advance peace. The child converts that same machinery into a short, definite four-power invitation following consultation with the French and British leaders and adds a proposed date and place. C02 is closely related background for arranging a top-level meeting through consultation with other interested nations, but it is less directly shaped as an invitation. C20 contains a direct meeting invitation but concerns a domestic presidential transition and shares only generic correspondence structure.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I therefore wish now to express my readiness to meet with you, President de Gaulle and Prime Minister Macmillan
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I am ready to meet with the Soviet leaders... with the attendance as appropriate of leaders of other states which have recognized responsibilities
shared_material.explanation: Both formulate presidential readiness for a high-level meeting with Soviet leadership and participation by other relevant heads of government.

shared_material.child_excerpt: As you are aware I have just met with President de Gaulle and Prime Minister Macmillan... We agreed that it would be desirable for the four Heads of State or Government to meet together
shared_material.parent_excerpt: It would be essential that prior to such a meeting these complex matters should be worked on in advance through diplomatic channels and by our Foreign Ministers... Arrangements should also be made for the appropriate inclusion... of other governments
shared_material.explanation: The child implements the parent’s proposed preparatory consultation and multilateral participation structure.

shared_material.child_excerpt: to discuss the main problems affecting the attainment of peace and stability in the world
shared_material.parent_excerpt: so that it can be ascertained that such a top-level meeting would, in fact, hold good hope of advancing the cause of peace and justice in the world
shared_material.explanation: The proposed summit is justified in both letters as a means of advancing international peace, with closely parallel functional language.
